1000834.etyen: A habitational surname from a Norwegian farm name. Store norske leksikon specifically gives Lillehammer as an older written surname form corresponding to the farm-name form Litlehamar. 1004930.etyen:
From keiser (“emperor”) + -dom (“domain, authority”), literally “an emperor's authority or domain”. The suffix -dom (“domain, authority; state or condition”) is from Old Norse -dómr, from Proto-Germanic *-dōmaz (“state, condition; domain, jurisdiction”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁- (“to put, place, do”). The base keiser (“emperor”) ultimately derives from Latin Caesar, through Germanic forms including Old Norse keisari and Middle Low German keiser; the further origin of the Latin name is uncertain.
